Save Registered Nurse – Medical/Surgical Unit at Larchmere Health Centre

About the job
As a Registered Nurse on our 32-bed Medical/Surgical unit, you will plan, deliver and evaluate care for adult patients recovering from surgery or managing complex medical conditions. You will work as part of an interdisciplinary team with physicians, physiotherapists and care aides, and you will be a calm, clear voice for patients and their families.

Responsibilities
- Assess patients, develop care plans and monitor vital signs and pain levels
- Administer medications and IV therapy safely and document care in the electronic health record (EHR)
- Provide wound care, post-operative care and patient education before discharge
- Recognize changes in a patient's condition and escalate to the charge nurse or physician
- Mentor nursing students and new graduates on the unit

Qualifications
- Current practising registration with the BC College of Nurses and Midwives (BCCNM) as a Registered Nurse
- Current BLS / CPR certification
- Minimum 1 year of acute care nursing experience
- Strong communication and critical thinking skills

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Cerner or another EHR system
- Specialty training in wound care or IV therapy

Larchmere Health Centre is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and are committed to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.
